item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.17
item.description: - No more guessing: when ConformTXT can't read the font where you're pasting, it pastes plain text in that spot's own font, never a font remembered from an earlier paste. - Nothing is quietly lost: superscripts and subscripts (m², CO₂) stay, visible text some sites mark for screen readers stays, definition lists keep their lines, and Word's footnote marks stay. - A copy with a picture that can't come along (from Word, Mail or Notes) is a normal paste, so the picture comes too. Plain text that would lose a link's address is a normal paste too. - Copying inside Pages, Numbers, Google Docs or Notion and pasting back into the same app keeps that app's own formatting. - Code and commands aren't mistaken for Markdown. - The invisible test character is only used in apps where it's been tested, and is checked before it's trusted. - ⌃⌘V right after a paste it can't swap no longer pastes the text twice.
